description: Set the products on a post's Shop the post sheet: link_ids from links_list, in the order the sheet lists them (at most 10); [] clears them. Each product keeps its counted short link and code. A product with on_bio false shows only on the sheet, not in the page's own list. The post shows on the bio page's grid once it's published with a photo or video. post_id is a post, or a synced Instagram post's post_id from shop_posts_list.

idempotency_key.description: Any unique string, e.g. a UUID. A retry with the same key within 24 hours returns the first call's result instead of doing it again.

workspace.description: Workspace ID. Optional when the connection has a default or only one workspace.

name: post_links_set
title: Attach products to a post
